description: Procurement for the Supply of 24,000 Vials of Infiximab Injection of 100mg Powder
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Infliximab Injection is used to reduce the symptoms of Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, as well as to treat certain types of arthritis. International competitive bids have been invited for the procurement of 24,000 vials of the said vaccine powder, and two (02) bids have been received for the same. Based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the said procurement to Celltrion Inc of the Republic of Korea (Manufacturer: CELLTRION Inc, Republic of Korea), the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a total cost of US$ 03 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
